answer: We design a Sybil-resistant protocol using zero-knowledge verifiable delay and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, where a consensus beacon enforces staking collateral to thwart identity forgery. As an adversarial nebula attempts identity multiplication, dynamic opportunity-cost bonds enforce a steep ridge of slashing penalties, yielding a strictly negative expected payoff. Thus, this capital barrier ensures Nash equilibrium, making rational attackers optimize toward non-participation to cement a robust, subgame-perfect equilibrium against Sybil attacks.
